thread:
anna_ae: Heads up 11 ZenPay (payments platform) wants to run a POC. Their checklist: SSO (SAML2) with encrypted assertions, SCIM delta sync (they call it syncToken), strict RBAC (per-user, per-queue), domain ownership verification before issuing prod keys, and audit forwarding to Splunk. They also asked about HSM options and key custody. Can we run this on Hosted for a POC or do they need Dedicated?

devon_se: Hosted works for feature validation. Encrypted assertions + syncToken SCIM are supported. HSM/key custody requires Dedicated or Private. For POC we can provide attestation and limited audit export to their Splunk dev instance.

mira_solutions: Quick runbook suggestions:
- Ask ZenPay for IdP metadata (want: entityID, ACS, cert) and a test group mapping file.
- Recommend initial bulk SCIM push then syncToken deltas for changes.
- Map SCIM groups -> Redwood role templates (we can demo custom role creation in Console).
- Block API key issuance until domain TXT verification completes.

samir_security: Security notes:
- Transport: TLS1.2+ (1.3 preferred).
- At-rest: AES-256-GCM; Hosted uses our KMS, Dedicated supports BYO-HSM.
- SAML: we support signed AuthnRequests and encrypted assertions (RSA-OAEP + AES-256-GCM).
- Audit: can stream to Splunk via HTTPS forwarder; we sign events with HMAC. Retention defaults vary by tier.

olivia_account: POC pricing: 14-day free POC with limited qps and token quota. If they need Dedicated (HSM, longer retention), we do a short-term reserved instance with pro-rated commit. I'll prepare two cost scenarios once we have estimated peak qps and avg seq length.

anna_ae: ZenPay also asked whether we support domain allowlist to stop onboarding from unverified emails.

mira_solutions: Yes 1 we can enforce allowlist at org creation and block self-serve invites until TXT verification. For POC we usually spin a staging org and map after verification.

devon_se: Example SCIM delta call for the POC token (they asked for curl):

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_POC_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/scim+json" \
  "https://staging-api.redwood-inference/prod/scim/v2/Users?syncToken=eyJhbGci...&count=200"

mira_solutions: Minimal SAML SP metadata we need (we can also supply a sample):

<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood-inference.staging/sp" xmlns="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:metadata">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="true" WantAssertionsSigned="true">
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://staging.redwood-inference/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>

samir_security: We'll assemble a secops packet with cert fingerprints, key rotation cadence, encryption algorithms, and audit streaming instructions. Need to know if ZenPay requires EU-only data residency.

olivia_account: Next steps:
- Anna: request IdP metadata + sample user CSV + expected peak qps.
- Mira: attach SCIM/SAML runbook to the POC ticket.
- Samir: prepare secops packet and production vs POC differences.
- Olivia: two pricing scenarios (Hosted POC free vs Dedicated short-term with HSM).

deploy-bot: staging/zenpay-identity-poc deployed -> https://staging.redwood-inference.prod/zenpay (SAML ACS + SCIM endpoints live). :white_check_mark:

anna_ae: Thanks team 1 I'll get their metadata this afternoon and post back here. :thumbsup:
